These appeals under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (the Act) have been filed by the claim petitioners in O.P.(MV) Nos.354/2013 and 353/2013 on the file of the Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Thalassery, (the Tribunal), aggrieved by the amount of compensation granted by Award dated 24/11/2018.

sentences.text: The sole respondent herein is the second respondent in the original petitions.
In these appeals, the parties and the documents will be referred to as described in the original petitions.

2. According to the claim petitioners, on 24/08/2012 at about 10:30 a.m., while the claim petitioner in O.P. (MV) No.353/2013 was riding scooter bearing registration no.PY01-TEM/H 7930 with the petitioner in O.P.(MV) No.354/2013 as pillion rider from Chittariparamba to M.A.C.A.Nos. 568 and 607 of 2020 2025:KER:41291 Kuthuparamba through Mananthavady - Kuthuparamba road, jeep bearing registration no.KL-58-A-7332 driven by the 1st respondent knocked them down causing grievous injuries.
3. The first respondent/driver of the offending vehicle filed written statement denying negligence on his part.
The accident was due to the negligence of the rider of the scooter.
The age, occupation and income of the petitioners were disputed.

4. The second respondent/insurer filed written statement admitting the issuance of a valid policy but denied the liability to pay compensation on the ground that the first respondent had not produced any documents in respect of the vehicle for verification and proof.
5. Before the Tribunal, no oral evidence was adduced by either side.
Exts. A1
to A16 and Exts.X1 and X2
were marked on the side of the claim petitioners.
No documentary evidence was adduced by the respondent.

6. The Tribunal on consideration of the documentary evidence and after hearing both sides, found the first M.A.C.A.Nos. 568 and 607 of 2020 2025:KER:41291 respondent driver of the offending vehicle to be negligent and accordingly passed a common Award granting a sum of 3,15,138/- to the claim petitioner in O.P.(MV) No.354/2013 and 3,51,004/- to the petitioner in O.P.(MV)
No.353/2013 together with interest @ 9% per annum from the date of the petitions till realisation along with proportionate costs.
